title: How to Do the Robot | MJ Dancing

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor breaks down Michael Jackson robot styles using casual explanations and rhythmic vocal sounds. He demonstrates each movement step-by-step from different angles to guide learners.

lesson_structure.note: Breakdown of the Billy Jean ticking robot style
Breakdown of the Human Nature robot style

metaphors: puts his hand on the wall

steps_taught.name: Billy Jean Ticking Robot
steps_taught.description: Walking motion with rigid ticking isolation across body parts.

steps_taught.name: Human Nature Robot
steps_taught.description: Wide stance with arms pushing and locking against invisible walls.

what_works: clear visual isolation of body parts

quotes.text: Let's do the first which would be the Billy Jean.
What you want to do is tick every part of your body.
Now we're going to do the Human Nature robot.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor talking directly to camera introducing two robot variations.
Instructor demonstrating profile ticking walk with bent knees and locked joints.

extraction.distinctive_method: Uses vocal sound effects like tick and shoop to emphasize robotic movements and locking actions.
